headline: Average Salary in Bishkek Exceeds 64 Thousand Soms » Gazeta.kg - News of Kyrgyzstan and Bishkek Today
summary: The average monthly wage in Bishkek reached 64,293 soms in the first half of 2026, 23 percent above the same period last year. City hall said incomes are outpacing price growth.
why: Wage growth relative to inflation is a key indicator of household purchasing power and consumer demand in Kyrgyzstan.
